_help: Words for /launch-your-toy/ (js/biz-launch.js). Prices and tiers are in toy_tiers.json. examples: made-up concepts shown as small playable demos, always labelled as examples. form: the request form questions.
label: For projects
title: Don't pay someone to post about your product. Let people play it.

why.title: KOLs sell impressions
why.text: A paid post is seen for a second and forgotten.

why.title: Quests attract farmers
why.text: People click through tasks for rewards, then leave.

why.title: Toys make people learn
why.text: They play, understand what you do, and share it because it was fun.

examplesLine: Made up for illustration. Tap Play to try a 30 second version.

examples.name: Don't Get Liquidated
examples.pitch: Borrow against your ETH, then survive a price drop. Players learn health factor and liquidation by feeling it.

examples.name: Beat the Slippage
examples.pitch: Pick a slippage setting before the market moves. Players learn why trades fail or get front-run.

examples.name: Bridge Puzzle
examples.pitch: Put the bridge steps in the right order, starting with checking you are on the real site. Players learn to bridge safely.

benefits.title: Real users who understand your product
benefits.text: Every player learns how it works, not just its name.

benefits.title: Organic shares
benefits.text: Share cards and certificates people post because they want to.

benefits.title: No farming
benefits.text: No token rewards, so there is nothing to farm. Prizes are merch or product perks only.

benefits.title: Launch week reach
benefits.text: Posts on @web3toys and a spot in the newsletter in your launch week.

benefits.title: An analytics dashboard
benefits.text: Plays, finishes, quiz scores and shares, on a private link.

benefits.title: Embed code
benefits.text: Put the toy on your own site with one line of code (Full Game and up).

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Send the form below and, if you like, pay a 50% deposit to reserve a build slot.

steps.title: 20 minute call
steps.text: We agree the idea, the key thing players should learn and your launch date.

steps.title: We build, you review
steps.text: You see it before anyone else and ask for changes.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: It goes live on web3.toys with launch posts, timed to your date.

faq.a: About 1 week for a Mini Toy, 2 weeks for a Full Game and 3 weeks for a Launch Tournament, from the call. Tell us your launch date early.

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: Your logo and colours, the one thing players should understand, links to your docs, and a person to answer questions during the build.

faq.q: How many revisions do we get?
faq.a: Two rounds of changes are included. Bigger changes after that are quoted first.
You can use it, embed it and share it as much as you like. web3.toys keeps the code and hosts it, so it stays fast and safe.
Yes, merch or product perks like fee discounts. Never tokens or crypto through web3.toys, and never anything that promises returns.

faq.q: Will you build for any project?
faq.a: No. Every project passes our vetting checklist first: a real product, a public or verifiable team, and no promises of returns. If we decline, your deposit is refunded in full.

form.product: What does your product do, in two sentences?
form.idea: Your idea, in your own words (optional)
form.agree: I understand every project is vetted first, there are no token rewards, and the deposit is refunded in full if you decline.

afterLine: Reserve your build slot with a 50% deposit, or book a call first.
loginNote: Log in first so you can follow your request. Your answers stay on this page.
